On H^1 mod11, independently constructed spanning-tree gauge and the multiplier-3 action matrix [[1,0],[8,3]], eigenvalues 1,3. The known integral order-33 torsion, established in source by unimodular Morse reduction and maximal minor gcd33 with 16x16 unit minor, then forces 11-primary action x3; order-five group action on Z/3 is trivial, giving 25 mod33. Source rotation order3 acts trivially since Aut(Z/33) has order20. The large integral Smith/minor computations were inspected in original proof and prior matching exact full result, but were not exhaustively rerun here; independent mod ranks alone would not prove full Smith form.
